name: HubTwoFactorSetup
description: Turning on two-step sign-in. It is required for the owner at the first sign-in after becoming owner. There is no "Sari peste" and no "Dezactivează" for the owner. The page is the AuthLayout component (S63), like HubSignIn and HubInvite: the brand panel, the sheet with the form and, on phones, the band with the logo and language. Locked after 5 wrong codes, for 15 minutes (S61). Shown at 1280 and 390, in light and dark, built only from the system's components. Every text is a key in `i18n/two-factor.json`, in the 6 languages.
